admission_requirements.text: Must be a graduate of a DepEd-accredited high school or hold a valid Philippine Educational Placement Test (PEPT) certificate eligible for college admission.

Qualification is determined by the University Predicted Grade (UPG), combining standardized UPCAT scores and the High School Weighted Average (Grades 8, 9, 10, and 11), subject to UP Manila campus and degree program quotas.
Complete UPCAT online application forms (including Form 1 and school-certified Form 2 high school records) through the UP Office of Admissions portal.
